ns2:section.sectionText: The rhizosphere is the zone of influence of roots in the soil. If the soil were a desert, the rhizosphere would be the oasis. Many important and complex biological interactions occur in this zone. The goal of this course is to provide hands-on experience collecting rhizosphere samples in the field and analyzing those samples in a laboratory setting. Field sampling will occur at the Forestry Farm (transportation provided), where necessary vegetation types exist to conduct all sampling activities.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Natural Resrcs & Environ Sci major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
